note: RRSSB configures social share/follow buttons as rrssb_button_set config entities (config prefix rrssb.button_set; a 'default' set ships on install). Keys: follow (0 share / 1 follow), chosen (per-button enabled/username/weight), appearance (size/alignRight/...), prefix. Rendered via the rrssb_block block, the rrssb_buttons Views field, or a node-type third-party setting (third_party_settings.rrssb.button_set). Icons/CSS come from the external rrssb/rrssb-plus library. Hooks hook_rrssb_buttons()/_alter() add or change buttons; drush rrssb:gen-css regenerates library CSS. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real button-set config entities on the live site - no live social-network calls are made.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal RRSSB (rrssb) module, what kind of configuration object represents a group of social share buttons, and what is the id of the one that ships when you install the module?
evals.expected_output: A 'button set' - a config entity of type rrssb_button_set (config prefix rrssb.button_set, objects named rrssb.button_set.<id>). Installing the module creates one set with id 'default'. Managed at /admin/config/content/rrssb.

evals.prompt: How can a custom module add a brand-new social network button (or change an existing one) to the RRSSB module?
evals.expected_output: Implement hook_rrssb_buttons() to add buttons (each with svg/svgfile, share_url and/or follow_url, color, etc.) or hook_rrssb_buttons_alter(&$buttons) to change existing ones.

evals.prompt: The RRSSB module ships a Drush command. What is it and what does it do?
evals.expected_output: drush rrssb:gen-css (alias rrssb-gen-css) regenerates css/rrssb.buttons.css inside the RRSSB+ library from the current button configuration; run it after adding/altering buttons.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has an RRSSB button set with the id rrssb_known. Inspect the live configuration and list which social buttons are enabled in it.
evals.expected_output: The rrssb_known button set (rrssb.button_set.rrssb_known) has email and facebook enabled in its 'chosen' list.

evals.prompt: The RRSSB button set rrssb_follow on this site is configured as follow buttons. Inspect the live configuration and state the username set for its twitter button.
evals.expected_output: rrssb.button_set.rrssb_follow has follow: 1 and its chosen.twitter.username is 'acmecorp'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create an RRSSB button set with the id rrssb_task and label 'Share', containing enabled email, facebook and linkedin share buttons. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A config entity rrssb.button_set.rrssb_task exists (type rrssb_button_set) with chosen.email, chosen.facebook and chosen.linkedin all enabled.

evals.prompt: Using the RRSSB module, create a button set called rrssb_align that shows the buttons right-aligned and puts the text 'Share this:' in front of them. Save it on the site.
evals.expected_output: A config entity rrssb.button_set.rrssb_align exists with appearance.alignRight === true and prefix === 'Share this:'.
